transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately that brought you here today?

I’m here because I keep losing my temper in ways that don’t feel like me. Like at work, I yelled at one of my employees just because they put stock on the wrong shelf. It was such a small thing, and afterward I was shaking. I don’t usually treat people like that, and it scared me.
Have you been feeling more irritable or angry than usual, even outside of these outbursts at work?

Yes. I’ve been much more on edge and angry than usual. It’s like I blow up over things that normally wouldn’t bother me much at all. The thing at work really scared me—I yelled at someone over stock being in the wrong place, and afterward I was shaking because that’s just not how I usually act.
Have you had times when your mood has been unusually high or you've felt extremely energetic or restless?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t felt unusually high or full of energy. If anything, I just feel tense and worked up, but not in a good or energetic way.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, even outside of these anger episodes?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve been depressed exactly, or lost interest in things in a clear way. Mostly I just feel upset and tense, and then I get angry too fast.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually irritable, more active than usual, or couldn’t sit still, even if you didn’t feel happy or energetic?

I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve been irritable, yes, but I haven’t noticed a period where I was more active than usual or couldn’t sit still in that kind of way. It’s more like I’m tense and easily set off.
Have you had days in a row where you felt down, sad, or hopeless, or where you really lost interest in most things, even if it wasn’t tied to feeling angry?

I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed days in a row where I’m just sad or hopeless, or where I don’t care about anything. It feels more like I’m upset and on edge, but I can’t say it’s a separate depressed feeling.
Have you had sudden episodes of anger that felt out of proportion to the situation, even outside of work, where you reacted strongly without thinking?

Yes. That’s actually why I’m here. I keep blowing up at people over things that don’t really deserve that kind of reaction. Like at work, I yelled at one of my employees just for putting stock on the wrong shelf, and afterward I was shaking because… that’s not how I usually treat people.
Can you tell me more about how you usually handle stress or conflict in your personal relationships?

Usually I don’t handle conflict like this. I mean, I can get frustrated, but I don’t normally blow up at people. Lately it’s like small things set me off, and I react way too strongly before I can stop myself. Like I said, yelling at my employee over the stock being on the wrong shelf… that was nothing, and afterward I was shaking because it really didn’t feel like me.
Have you noticed yourself feeling physically restless, like you can't sit still or need to move around, especially when you're feeling tense or irritable?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed that I can’t sit still or anything like that. When I’m tense, I feel worked up, but I don’t know if I’m physically restless exactly.
Have you had episodes of anger or aggression where you just felt like exploding, even when there wasn’t a clear reason or trigger for it?

Yes. That’s been happening. I’ll just feel like I’m about to explode over something small, or almost nothing. Like I said, I yelled at my employee for putting stock on the wrong shelf, and afterward I was shaking because that’s just… not how I usually treat people.
Have you had little interest or pleasure in doing things, or felt down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
I don’t think so, not for two weeks like that. I’ve been upset and not myself, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt depressed or hopeless most of the day nearly every day.
Have you ever had sudden episodes of anger where you lost control and acted aggressively, even when there wasn’t a clear reason or anything specific that set it off?

Yes. That’s basically why I’m here. I keep blowing up at people over things that don’t really justify it. Like with my employee—I yelled at them just for putting stock on the wrong shelf, and afterward I was shaking. That’s not how I usually act.
Have you had multiple episodes of anger where you exploded or lost control, even when there was no clear reason or trigger, and these outbursts caused problems in your work or relationships?

Yes. It’s happened more than once, and it’s starting to affect work. I keep blowing up over things that are so small—like when I yelled at one of my employees just because they put stock on the wrong shelf. Afterward I was shaking, because that’s not how I usually treat people.
Have you had times when you felt irritable even when nothing specific was happening, just a general sense of being on edge or easily annoyed?

Yes. I feel like I’m just on edge a lot, even when nothing is really happening. I keep snapping at people over little things, like at work when I yelled at my employee for putting stock on the wrong shelf. Afterward I was shaking because I don’t normally treat people like that.
Have you had problems with anger like this before, or is this something that’s new for you?

This is new for me. I mean, I’ve gotten annoyed before like anyone, but not like this—blowing up over nothing. Yelling at my employee over stock being on the wrong shelf… that’s not how I usually treat people. I was shaking afterward because it felt so unlike me.
